title: Codex原文污染诊断：对照官方及固定公共数据
hypothesis: Identify direct instruction/environment leakage and distinguish source-format differences from unidentifiable implicit prompt effects.
changes: Scan all 1000 final texts and raw completion events
Compare matched four-model official and fixed public views separately
Control model balance and length strata; retain 20 paired-route controls

config.note: 仅作台账索引；完整参数以 config_path 指向的 config.json 为准。

execution.scope: Offline descriptive diagnostics only; no training or generation

validation.scope: 1000-text direct trace checks, same-label source comparison and 20 paired controls; no causal/API-equivalence or training-utility acceptance
validation.leakage_audit: direct instruction traces screened; exact overlap checked; semantic prompt overlap not fully established

conclusion: No explicit instruction/tool/environment trace detected in 1000 responses. Codex newline 70.9%, bold 21.5%; major format shift is confounded by explicit public-source instructions/filtering. Cannot infer hidden-prompt causality.
limitations: Unknown official requests/backend snapshots; public views overlap and use differing prompts, reasoning and preprocessing. Only 10 independent prompt groups in paired controls. No training or utility evaluation.
next_action: Keep Codex raw source isolated; consider controlled repeated same-prompt/format collection and later fixed-group validation only if requested.
